Horse Keane’s Hornpipe et al

Here is a link to how I currently play the tune which I wrote for my late Dad Jimmy, who earned the nickname the “Horse” as an ironworker here in Chicago during the 1960’s. The following two reels were also composed by me - The Rath Cairn Reel and The Charleston Reel….

http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZRsVdq51NyU&feature=player_embedded#!
